Title: Private Playback
Intro: Choose which playback state Jellyfin may persist for each user. Identity is matched by the immutable user ID.
LoadError: The configuration could not be loaded.
UserMissing: This saved user ID no longer exists. Select Normal and save to remove this stale entry.
NormalDescription: Jellyfin stores progress, watched state and playback history normally.
PrivateDescription: Progress, watched state, play count and last-played date are not changed.
CustomDescription: Choose each protected playback field separately.
RememberProgressHelp: Allows resume position and Continue Watching to change.
RememberWatchedHelp: Allows played/unplayed state and derived watched indicators to change.
RecordHistoryHelp: Allows play count and last-played date to change.
SaveError: The configuration could not be saved.
CleanupWarning: Optional and destructive: clears only progress, watched state, play count and last-played date. Favourites, ratings and track choices remain.
ConfirmPrompt: Permanently clear the existing playback data for this user? This cannot be undone.
ClearResult: Playback data was cleared from {count} item(s).
LimitationText: Jellyfin clients may still display watched controls. Server-side enforcement is authoritative; this plugin does not patch client applications.
